primary_units: mL, sample volume uL; observed strict one-factor pairs only
aggregation: pair mean within seed/endpoint, then equal formal model means; molecule and series stratifications are descriptive. Crossed AL/formal seeds are not paired randomized replications.

validation_sparse_reference.scope: descriptive engineering coverage flags, not power or significance guarantees

response_reference_bands.scope: report each endpoint and all three formal seeds; do not force one binary pass from pooled pairs

decision_logic: train and validation recover: architecture has capacity, study early label coverage; no LLM value claim
train improves but validation poor: separate coverage/interactions/overfit/noise
train remains compressed: data scale alone insufficient under these trained models; diagnose branch/loss/dynamics, no automatic architecture change
seed heterogeneity: all three reported; no best-seed selection
matched_primary: same exact pair IDs present at L525 and L1005 for each AL seed, legally train/val in the evaluated formal split and no quarantined endpoint; L1485 is an all-five-seed existing-checkpoint extension
curve_pool: 15 metadata-hash ordered volume series from legal common AL pairs, maximum3 per ALseed, at least2 observed levels; freeze IDs before predicting curves
curve_support: global domain30..150; outside per-series observed min/max marked local extrapolation; curves do not score errors at synthetic levels
curve_examples: within frozen pool: first hash qualifying recovered(span>=1mL and >=5x AL1005), all-formal-flat(span<.1mL), or formal seed spread>1mL; absent types explicitly absent; all pool curves exported
label_boundary_exception: Separate incident record; no claim of zero historical test-value visibility; quarantine applied before all numeric scoring
